1: Olympus
While the Olympus housemates prepare for eviction night, hordes of zombies suddenly attack, sending the production crew scrambling for shelter.
The Show Is Over
At Olympus, Nina is met with skepticism by the housemates. In the city, Ana and son Léo weigh their options. Cleide's condition quickly worsens.
Grocery Store
Nina, TK and Marcos sneak out for medical supplies. Stuck in the greenroom, Brandão and Jessica get on each other's nerves. Ana and Léo hit the road.
Zeus
While Brandão and Jessica deal with Divina, the housemates assess their situation. Stopped by Levi's police escorts, Ana and Léo must negotiate.
The End
Brandão's rash decision endangers the housemates. Trapped in the van, Levi's group fights back, while Jessica tries to help Nina from the control room.
Wild Thing
Teresa and Robson undertake a risky mission. Léo tells Teresa about Ana's past. The group finds an army of biters inside Olympus, but Ana has a plan.
The Calling
With the clock ticking, Ana tries to restore communication channels. The group debates whether to allow other survivors into the compound.
The Future
Short of options, Ana takes one for the team. Levi plays God with a new group of survivors. Teresa and Léo grow closer.
The Gate
Teresa questions Levi’s methods, while Robson goes rogue. Seriously outnumbered by zombies, the group desperately attempts to regain territory.
Be Human
Between a militia vying for control and Levi's underhanded tactics, the survivors are caught in a web of hatred, lies and betrayal.
